4.4% represents the highest possible unionized presence that could exist in NVIDIA’s workforce. 
Employees in Brazil are unionized, and employees in Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Italy, 
Netherlands, Poland, and Sweden could participate in unions but NVIDIA is legally not allowed to inquire 
about their involvement. There are collective bargaining agreements in Belgium, Finland, France, Israel, and 
Italy, covering 12.7% of our employee population.
